subject: English Home Language
theme: More words we know by sight

source.subtopic: Group guided: uses sight words, phonics, context and structural analysis; begins to monitor self; builds sight vocabulary

show.line: More words to know by sight. Have, here, like, little, look, with, come, went. Read them fast!

rounds.prompt: I have a little dog. Which word is missing? I, gap, a little dog.
rounds.praise: Have! I have a little dog.

rounds.story: Lulu says, come and look! Her brother comes. He looks at the little bird. Which word did Lulu say first?

rounds.prompt: Does this word look right? Read it and check. I like cake.
rounds.praise: Yes! It looks right and it makes sense.

hints: Look at the whole word. You know this one!
Read the sentence again. Which word makes sense?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this sentence. Come here, little cat.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That word is here, not have. Come here, little cat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. Come here, little cat!

parent_line: Can read more common words by sight and check that a sentence makes sense.
